answer: A remote attestation quotes the enclave code before the identity is allowed to act, and the chain groups identities by quoted measurement, so a farm running one image in one fleet collapses into a single counted voter. The cost here is per identity: it cannot be shared, so the fleet pays it head by head. The haven is the quoted measurement, the island the group it forms, and the forge the voice that group is worth; the haven and the island collapse a farm, while only a fresh forge of hardware escapes the grouping.
